premise.claim: The Security page alerts this PR targets are real and open: 17 open aiohttp Dependabot alerts (82-101, all <=3.14.3 or <3.14.4) in the mooncake e2e lock, Dependabot 102 scikit-learn<1.5.0 (CVE-2024-5206) in the vineyard sample lock, code-scanning 1481/1482 (pythonsecurity:S8707 path traversal) on hack/sdk/post-gen.py, and 14 alerts under sdk/python fixed by submodule bump to fluid-client-python#12.

tests.expected: 18 open Dependabot (17 aiohttp + 1 scikit-learn) + 16 open code-scanning (2 post-gen.py + 14 sdk/python)

tests.expected: exit 1: aiohttp==3.14.4 requires yarl<2.0,>=1.25.1 but lock pins yarl==1.24.5

b06de4e8 is merge of #12, master HEAD, 8 files changed

findings.title: No committed test for the post-gen.py allow-list behavior change
findings.evidence: PR body states no new tests; hack/sdk/post-gen.py resolve_sdk_path behavior changed from any-in-repo-path acceptance to allow-list, and no test in the repo covers it. Harness on this branch supplies 10 contract tests.

tests.expected: 10/10 pass on PR head; rejection tests + decoy-dir test fail on base script (bite check recorded in results/post-gen-bite-check-base.txt)

findings.title: SDK output path constant duplicated across gen-sdk.sh and post-gen.py
findings.evidence: hack/sdk/gen-sdk.sh PYTHON_SDK_OUTPUT_PATH and post-gen.py PYTHON_SDK_DIRS must stay in sync manually; PR notes acknowledge. Failure mode is loud (SystemExit), so risk is low.
